comparison.objective: Sharpen both sides of a kitchen knife on a whetstone at a controlled angle; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained blade-angle, contact-force and stroke control with safe reorientation versus recessed-tool insertion, fine rotary adjustment, locking and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Specified sharpening coverage/angle and safe final placement versus acceptable carriage dynamics after locking. Candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Contact-rich abrasive surface following is a different tested ability from mechanical adjustment and impact testing.
